name: Pie

variants.label: Pie Chart
variants.tooltip: A standard pie chart that displays a list of items, each of which has a value that is part (percentage) of the total.

variants.label: Flat Chart
variants.tooltip: A standard pie chart that displays a list of items, each of which has a value that is part (percentage) of the total.

variants.label: Three Dimensional
variants.tooltip: A standard pie chart that displays a list of items, each of which has a value that is part (percentage) of the total.

label.description: Name of subject of current pie section

value.description: Value which determines percentage of chart current pie section occupies

data.description: Data source for this chart. Each object within array defines the name and value for a single pie section.

items.description: Color for a single pie section

colors.description: Colors that correspond to each pie section, respective of order in data

title.description: Name to display for this chart

valueFormat.description: Label and legend value format configuration

showValueAsPercent.description: Whether to show the value as a percent of total or the raw value

showPercentSymbol.description: Whether to show the percent symbol next to the percent value

showLabels.description: Whether to show labels for each section of this chart

showName.description: Whether to show the name on the label

showValue.description: Whether to show the value on the label. Hiding values will disable any value formats set

bent.description: Bend labels around slices. Bending labels will disable the align and wrap properties

align.description: Whether the labels should be aligned in vertical columns

enabled.description: Whether the labels should show inside of the chart slices, based on if the value percentage is below the percentLimit threshold. Displaying labels inside the chart will disable bent and align properties

radius.description: Distance in percentage towards center of pie chart while inside is enabled. 0 represents outside edge while 100 would be directly in the middle

color.description: Label color for labels while they are displayed inside the chart

percentLimit.description: Value that determines at what value percentage to place label on outside of chart instead of inside

tooltipFormat.description: Value that determines the format of the tooltips.

showLegend.description: Value that determines whether to show a legend for this chart or hide it

enabled.description: Value that determines whether to show the legend icons or hide them

legendLabelColor.description: The color of the legend labels

cutoutRadius.description: Percent of total radius to cut out of center of chart. If greater than zero, chart becomes ring-style instead of pie.

selection.description: An object that contains selection related properties.

enabled.description: Enables selection of pie chart slices.

data.description: A read-only list of currently selected pie chart slice

width.description: Thickness of border around each pie section

color.description: Color of border around each pie section

opacity.description: Opacity of border around each pie section. 0 is fully transparent, 1 is fully opaque.

enableTransitions.description: Whether chart has visual transition effects for changes in chart data

threeDimensional.description: Whether chart has a depth effect to look three-dimensional
